headline: Iranian drones struck the US Ali Al Salem base in Kuwait
summary: Iran's armed forces said they struck the Ali Al Salem military base in Kuwait, which hosts US forces, using drones. The attack was reported by the Iranian army press service.
why: Brent crude is the main global oil benchmark, and Gulf military escalation is closely watched because the region produces a large share of world oil supply.
why_moved: An Iranian drone strike on a US base in Kuwait raises the risk of wider Gulf conflict, which can lift oil prices on supply-disruption fears.
original_headline: Иранские беспилотники ударили по базе США Али аль-Салем в Кувейте
